title: Prove production Gaussian inverse bound 2 + 2p/u² (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written mathematical proof with finite corroboration. Under the unchanged physical Gaussian production guards, and conditional on the cited kernel and coefficient estimates, the original-coordinate rounded matrix H and every nonempty principal restriction satisfy

```diff
- Historical inverse infinity-norm bound: 8p
+ New inverse infinity-norm bound: 2 + 2p/u²
+ New rounded row gap: greater than u²/(2(p+u²))
```

The new step retains `u*theta > u²/(4p)` from `u*d <= p` and `theta > 1/(4d)`. On the published `p=16384, u=32` metadata example, the new upper bound is **34**, instead of **131072**. These are analytic bounds, not measured norms. This answers the row-gap part of PR6099's Open next questions. No new κ or selected-frontier change.

The bilateral majorant is cited from PR1673. PR6099's retained-band perturbation theorem, at `38ce77a4925c18eb66f94634b1b11a1242af8a87`, is a mathematical premise conditional on PR6085. Their re-verification is not the deliverable. The six new files are confined to `research/production-gaussian-rowgap/`.

## Evidence

- Before: the physical producer states an `8p` inverse bound, while PR6099 leaves uniform row dominance open under its coefficient theorem.
- After: `PROOF.md` proves the stronger universal implication. Each registered check passes on 139850 exact rational parameter fixtures, 2976 geometry pairs, 1024 rounding-budget fixtures, five rejected parameter cases and one removed-similarity counterexample. The parameter fixtures are a relaxation, not complete production plans.
- CPython 3.12, standard library. Registered normal and optimized checks took 0.570s and 0.583s locally, each below its 60s timeout. The direct warnings-as-errors/development-mode check also passed.
- Package metadata, exact committed bytes, source ancestry and executable modes passed. The official export and input-coverage check passed for 11 package/input files. Both normal and optimized direct checks passed in a read-only Git-free export with all 12 exported files unchanged, including the generated export manifest.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/production-gaussian-rowgap
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/production-gaussian-rowgap --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B research/production-gaussian-rowgap/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B research/production-gaussian-rowgap/verify.py
```

Use another CPython 3.12 executable in other environments. The verifier prints `PASS_PRODUCTION_GAUSSIAN_ROWGAP`; finite fixtures corroborate the written proof rather than establishing its universal quantifiers.

## Limitations

Conditional on the existing bilateral row majorant and PR6099/PR6085 coefficient estimates. No independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. The infinite-periodized comparison and tail, column/spectral norms, LU growth, full production pages, physical setup/tape cost, tensor/CRT assembly and the complete multiplier remain unproved here. No predecessor scientific replay, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. The five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Open next questions

- Reprice one actual caller's inverse-error term using the retained u² factor, preserving its separate column, Schur and tape obligations.
- Prove the separate retained-band-to-infinite-periodized comparison and tail left in PR6099, starting with the exact omitted offsets across the physical seam.

## Related open work

- #6099 supplies the conditional retained-band perturbation theorem and asks the row-gap question answered here; its infinite-tail question remains open.
- #6085 supplies the scalar enclosure theorem cited by #6099; this contribution adds a matrix-conditioning consequence without replaying that scalar result.

- #6131 studies the same ideal nearest-grid Gaussian kernel while varying concentration, and proves a sharp dominance/failure threshold. This contribution instead retains the unchanged production guard and bounds the rounded inverse; no common numerical inverse value is compared.

Credit Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml for PR3851, JoyboyBrian for PR6099/PR6085, Vlado Vojdanovski and the credited PR1673 phase-cell contributors, RaD/hipotures, Chafik Boukhalfa and the retained source-specific lineage. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## CI notes

CI is **uncertified** for commit `5e09c60005dd6ae454eef8271c0c2d2dba62c12e`. In [run 40692647641](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40692647641), `plan` failed during Onboarding helper tests and `replay (research/production-gaussian-rowgap)` was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI.**

The exact failures are inherited from canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, the PR6030 κ-admission commit pushed with `[skip ci]`. Its selected-record/documentation mismatch is unrelated to this isolated package:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects the exact marker `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. The document instead bolds `0.003125804 = 781451/250000000` together, so that marker is absent.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in `docs/ci.md`, which still describes #5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

The failed-job log reports 678 onboarding tests, two failures and 23 skips. [PR6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027) fails the same two tests, confirmed from its failed-job log.

All package checks reported above passed locally; none was certified by this hosted run. **The PR needs a maintainer re-run after main's documentation is fixed.** No branch push, main-documentation edit or CI re-run was performed for this blocker.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The package is isolated and can be reverted.

**Blast Radius:** research. No shared implementation, frozen evidence or selected record changes.
